name: init context
func:
// Seeds the loop on deploy. Plant characteristics live in the
// "process library" node next door -- edit that to add your own.
var cfg = {
  preset: 'bench',
  ts: 0.2,            // controller scan AND integration step, seconds
  window: 180,        // trend width, seconds of process time

  // --- plant -------------------------------------------------------
  model: 'fopdt',     // 'fopdt' (self-regulating) | 'integrating' (level)
  K: 1.6,             // process gain, %PV per %OP
  tau: 12.0,          // dominant time constant, s
  theta: 3.0,         // dead time, s
  Ki: 0.35,           // ramp rate for the integrating plant, %PV/s per %OP
  lead: 0.0,          // inverse-response time, s (>0 = shrink and swell)
  tau2: 0.0,          // second-order stage, s (0 = off)
  zeta2: 1.0,         // its damping ratio (<1 = resonant)
  rate: 0.0,          // actuator slew limit, %/s (0 = unlimited)
  pvBias: 8.0,        // PV with the valve shut
  noise: 0.25,        // measurement noise, 1 sigma in %
  dist: 0.0,          // load disturbance, in %OP at the valve

  // --- controller (ISA / dependent form, Ti and Td in SECONDS) ------
  extPID: false,      // true = OpenPLC drives OP over Modbus
  auto: false,        // start in MANUAL, bump test first, then go to auto
  action: 'reverse',  // 'reverse' = output falls as PV rises
  sp: 50.0,
  Kc: 1.0,
  Ti: 20.0,
  Td: 0.0,
  bias: 0.0,          // manual reset. Only bites when Ti = 0; with integral
                      // action the integral absorbs it within a few Ti.
  N: 10,              // derivative filter ratio, Tf = Td/N
  opMan: 30.0,
  opMin: 0.0,
  opMax: 100.0
};

flow.set('cfg', cfg);
flow.set('st', {
  simT: 0,                       // process clock, ms -- not wall clock
  pvTrue: cfg.K * cfg.opMan + cfg.pvBias, pv: cfg.K * cfg.opMan + cfg.pvBias,
  pvf: cfg.K * cfg.opMan + cfg.pvBias, pvfPrev: cfg.K * cfg.opMan + cfg.pvBias,
  lag1: cfg.K * cfg.opMan + cfg.pvBias,
  y2: cfg.K * cfg.opMan + cfg.pvBias, v2: 0,
  op: cfg.opMan, opRL: cfg.opMan, I: cfg.opMan - cfg.bias, delay: [],
  P: 0, D: 0, e: 0,
  iae: 0, tEvent: 0, pvAtEvent: 0, peak: 0, tSettle: 0
});
flow.set('hist', []);
